claim_boundary: Finite same-public-target selected engineering optimization. FIFO bucket-index prefetch plus an out-of-line unchanged relation verifier improves matched default-thread and one-worker full cost while preserving every relation and group certificate. Full IC remains far behind automorphism rho; no SOTA or asymptotic claim.

decision.reason: default panel median IC wall improves 12.46 percent and whole CPU 4.36 percent; one-worker IC wall improves 10.97 percent and whole CPU 7.89 percent; all exact outputs match

mechanism.name: admitted_bucket_index_prefetch
mechanism.rule: scan the presence filter in key order, retain admitted offsets in a FIFO, prefetch each admitted key bucket_start entry, then consume the FIFO in the original order
mechanism.verification_isolation: mark the unchanged exact relation verifier inline(never) to keep query-loop code layout from perturbing verification

process_accounting.scope: eight one-unit pilots, eight unisolated complete workflows, eight selected default-thread workflows, and two matched one-worker workflows; compilation excluded

validation: all one-unit arms emit one identical 2157-relation hash
all 18 complete workflows emit one identical 31798-relation hash, derive all logs and verify the same unknown scalar
every paired default-thread relation-unit wall and CPU comparison favors the selected candidate
the matched one-worker candidate improves IC wall and whole CPU
exact windowed-witness tests pass with the selected source
